caption:
You're sincere, disciplined, sure you're right. What if you're aimed the wrong way? Follow a wrong map faithfully, and you arrive faithfully at the wrong place. (Galatians 1:12-16 devotional)

You measure faith by how hot you burn — stronger conviction, deeper devotion, surely nearer the truth. But Paul burned hotter than anyone, blameless in the law, and aimed it all at crushing God's own church; zeal without direction only destroys. You don't reason your way to the real Jesus — He reveals Himself and corrects the one you'd built in your head.
